I changed line 2 in money.py from:
    return int(text.replace(' ', '', 1))
to:
    return int(text.replace(' ', ''))

This fix ensures all spaces are removed from salary strings, allowing proper parsing of salaries with thousands separators like "1 200 000" into integers like 1200000.

The fix was minimal and targeted - only the broken module was modified while all other modules (parse.py, clean.py, pipeline.py, rules.py) remained unchanged. All tests pass, confirming that:
